title: Alchemy and Doppler modernisation tasks
principles: Preserve the single Website resource and exact stage and state identity.
Treat local proof, provider state and hosted behaviour as different claims.
Keep secret values out of source, logs, caches, artefacts and receipts.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit each coherent slice after its focused checks and documentation impact pass.
evidenceRequired: Exact release versions and reference source revisions
Resource identity and one-resource graph comparison
Secret-name inventory with source, consumer and bootstrap exception
Local check results separated from provider and hosted proof

downstreamArtifactImpact: Change required: infrastructure package, root composition, imports, tests and deployment input digests.
Change required: deployment and package architecture, app/tool/package READMEs, runbook, active SPEC/tasks/plan and indexes.
Change required where applicable: manifests, lockfile, version-bound fixtures, generated OpenAPI, local package-structure profile and Changeset.
Preserve: historical provider receipts, authority model, protected GitHub environments, public MDX and stable resource identity.

tasks.title: Move the unchanged Website graph to one infrastructure owner
tasks.goal: Give the root a small composition role with one typed resource graph.
outputs: Private source-only package with stage Schema, Website policy and one-resource stack
Updated package imports, digests, tests and canonical documentation
qualityAudits: Check one Website, exact identities and properties, no app Alchemy dependency, no helper sprawl or unsafe casts.
Check installed Effect Schema and Config APIs and documentation impact rows.
completionCriteria: Root composition, architecture and READMEs agree.

tasks.title: Upgrade Alchemy and the matching Effect v4 family
tasks.goal: Use current compatible published releases without changing the public docs behaviour.
outputs: Current-version parser with fresh provider capture still required, preserved historical fixtures and package Changeset
browserVerification: Run the repository docs Worker/browser journey when build behaviour changes.
qualityAudits: Inspect Schema errors, OpenAPI and Website props against exact release source and installed types.
Scan for duplicate DTOs, unsafe casts, raw provider clients and pass-through helpers.
Keep secret-bearing output out of fixtures and receipts.
completionCriteria: Frozen install and local tests pass.
Current plan parser accepts qualified current output; historical fixtures remain correctly labelled.
If fresh version-matched provider output is unavailable, hosted parser proof remains open and deployment stops.
Version and proof limits are documented.

tasks.title: Reconcile Doppler and deployment workflow contracts
tasks.goal: Prove one governed source and the exact consumer for each manageable credential.
outputs: Secret-name inventory and safe metadata readback
qualityAudits: Check fixed dev, ci, stg_preview and prd config selection, least privilege, no fallback and no secret value output.
Check GitHub bootstrap tokens are the only direct bridge; preserve host-issued GitHub token and Alchemy state ownership.
completionCriteria: Every secret name has a source and consumer.
No duplicate direct-source credential remains where replacement has been proven.

tasks.title: Close local proof and qualify hosted delivery
tasks.goal: Confirm exact candidate locally and in hosted checks before merging.
scope: GitHub pull request and hosted checks
outputs: Remote main readback when merge is authorised
browserVerification: Obtain exact-candidate hosted Preview and Production proof only after resource-specific authority and plan review.
qualityAudits: Name principal, action, resource, environment, approval, receipt, rollback and readback before each external mutation.
Do not infer deployment or public availability from local checks.
completionCriteria: Required local and hosted checks pass or an exact blocker is recorded.
PR is reviewed and merged only within the authority model.
Remote main and plan lifecycle are read back.
